_meta.scope: COMBAT-SIDE background cards. One per character, kept on the SHEET - outside the 20-card loadout (14 class + 3 weapon + 3 skill). Not a played card: no timing circle.
_meta.authority: CANONICAL for background card text. Transcribed from backgrounds_print_cards_63x88mm.html (Drive).
coreRules: One background per character. FREE - no deck-slot cost.
Cultural or racial identity. 1-2 low-maintenance effects.
Because backgrounds are free, pure-upside ones must be SMALL. A downside only balances an upside if it costs the SAME builds that want the upside.
NO MAX-HP AS A DOWNSIDE - HP moves in multiples of 10, so the smallest penalty is -50% on HP20 classes. Downsides cost Block, hand size, healing, or damage-taken instead.
No party-scaling amplifiers. Existing keywords only.
_meta.printNote: Blue band #3a6ea5, blue 'BACKGROUND' bar label #2c537a, no timing circle. Tag colors: PASSIVE #5a6470, 1x #c7a13a (dark text), 2x #2f8f5f, TRIGGER #9a5bd0, COST #b0413a. Per-combat counts render green #2f8f5f in body text.

watchList: Wildkin / Quick-Handed / Long-Memoried are card advantage - they inverse-scale toward strong combo classes (Chronomancer, Assassin).
Grave-Touched inverse-scales toward squishies, whose glass-cannon risk it partly erases. Top candidate for per-day gating if it overperforms.
Forest-Dweller is party-only - dead in solo sims, must be measured in party.
Mountain-Born's reduce-by-4 is guaranteed, so slightly stronger than 4 Block. Flag if it overperforms.
Fortune-Touched is own-dice-only by ruling - no enemy rerolls, so no defensive no-sell and no party stacking.

backgrounds.name: Mountain-Born
backgrounds.effect: The first hit you take each combat is reduced by **4**.
backgrounds.notes: Guaranteed value, unlike turn-1 Block which often goes unused. Self-capping against small hits.

backgrounds.name: Wildkin
backgrounds.effect: On your first turn, draw **2** extra cards.
backgrounds.notes: Opening consistency; strongest on combo and burst classes.

backgrounds.name: Emberborn
backgrounds.effect: Your first attack each combat also applies **Burn**.
backgrounds.notes: One-time self-contained DoT. Burn refreshes, never stacks.

backgrounds.name: Nomad
backgrounds.effect: Once per combat, gain **+1 Normal or Slow** play.
backgrounds.notes: One extra action. NOT Fast - Fast is premium.

backgrounds.name: Battle-Fury
backgrounds.effect: The first time you take damage each combat, gain **+1 Strength** for the rest of it.
backgrounds.notes: Self-balancing: rewards classes that actually get hit, i.e. the frontline.

backgrounds.name: Forest-Dweller
backgrounds.effect: Once per combat, when an ally first drops below half HP, apply **Regen 3** to them.
backgrounds.notes: Six healing over time. PARTY-ONLY - does nothing solo; sim-flag like Chains' Set Up.

backgrounds.name: Old-Blood Scholar
backgrounds.effect: Look at the top card of your deck anytime. Once per combat, draw it.
backgrounds.notes: Foresight plus one tutor-draw. The scry is sneaky-strong but adds no raw damage.

backgrounds.name: Grave-Touched
backgrounds.effect: Once per combat, the first hit that would drop you to **0** leaves you at **1** instead.
backgrounds.notes: Death-save; most valuable on squishies. Gate to per-day if it overperforms.

backgrounds.name: Stoic
backgrounds.effect: You are immune to the first debuff applied to you each combat.
backgrounds.notes: Anti-control; matchup-dependent - dead against debuff-light enemies.

backgrounds.name: Fortune-Touched
backgrounds.effect: Twice per combat, reroll any number of dice in one of your **own** rolls.
backgrounds.notes: OWN DICE ONLY - no enemy rerolls. A variance-smoother, not a ceiling-raiser: rescues a botched payoff. Scales with how swingy the loadout is.

backgrounds.name: Ambusher
backgrounds.effect: Your first strike each combat deals an additional **1d4** and applies **1 Stagger**.
backgrounds.notes: Control plus damage opener. One strike only, so it cannot trivially trip a Stagger threshold.

backgrounds.name: Far-Traveled
backgrounds.effect: Twice per combat, discard a card to draw a card.
backgrounds.notes: Filtering, not advantage - net-neutral on card count. Low power, high consistency.

backgrounds.name: Quick-Handed
backgrounds.effect: Your hand size is reduced by **1**. **Three times** per combat, draw **2** cards.
backgrounds.notes: Net card-positive engine; the -1 hand is an honest cost in the same currency as the payoff. Heaviest tracking - a constant AND a counter.

backgrounds.name: Long-Memoried
backgrounds.effect: From your 4th turn each combat, draw **1** extra card every turn.
backgrounds.notes: Attrition snowball; value equals fight length, the hardest axis to balance. Lives or dies in the Attrition column.
